schemaNote: Phase 0B.2 evidence-status ledger (Issue #182 / PR #183 comment #5774835400). This is the single source of truth for 'how much of the owner-reported 172-entry PIZZA DB population does this repo actually have externally-relayed evidence for, and how much is still missing.' No name, count, or recipe row in this file is invented -- every 'pending' entry has zero content, by design, until real evidence is relayed. Read by tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py, which fails the build if this file's own invariants are violated (see that script's docstring).

ja-172.label: PIZZA DB Japanese canonical population (日本語トップ/比較ページ)

en-160.label: PIZZA DB English translated subset (key name 'en-160' kept stable as an identifier -- see sizeHistory; NOT re-fetched every Phase, so treat claimedTotal as this session's last-observed value, not a live count)

sizeHistory.note: Fresh evidence relayed in the Phase 0B.15 trigger comment: PIZZA DB's English index now itself reports 172 translated pizza profiles, the same SIZE as ja-172. This is a size coincidence, not proof of per-item correspondence -- explicitly NOT treated as evidence that en's membership now equals ja-172's membership. See en172UnconfirmedCandidatesPhase0B15 below for the concrete case this discipline was applied to.

en-160.note: A translated set intended to mirror ja-172, not a separate or interchangeable population, and not provably identical in MEMBERSHIP even now that it matches in SIZE. No count, name, or ingredient sourced from en-160/en-172 may be used to mark a ja-172 gap as filled without independent Japanese-side confirmation (a fetched Japanese profile page, or an exact ingredient-set match against already-evidenced ja-172 rows). Enforced by tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py's population-tag check (key name 'en-160' kept as the stable invariant-check target, not renamed to avoid a tooling change outside this Phase's scope).

recipeRowEvidence.evidencedCountNote: Updated in Phase 0B.15: 25 Phase-0B-original comparison_table_sample rows + 113 later comparison_table_sample rows (pages 4, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 batches) + 16 individual_profile_page rows = 154, all deduplicated against each other. Phase 0B.15 added 1 new row (pizza-de-lomo-saltado, via a DIRECTLY-FETCHED JAPANESE profile page, not an English-index translation). 3 further EN-index candidates (Black Truffle, Hokkaido Cheese, Lahmacun) were explicitly NOT ingested here -- see en172UnconfirmedCandidatesPhase0B15 below; they remain outside evidencedCount pending Japanese-side confirmation. 40 relayed rows across Phase 0B.5-0B.15 corroborated already-evidenced dishes, see corroborationsCount below. Full detail and per-row dedup/mechanic/evidence-gap/naming-ambiguity notes: docs/reports/data/TETO_PROGRESS2_PHASE0B4_recipe-row-evidence.json.
recipeRowEvidence.corroborationsNote: 40 relayed rows across Phase 0B.5-0B.15 matched an already-evidenced dish. Phase 0B.15 added 1: breakfast-pizza-pizzadb-p11, manual review, matched against PIZZA DB's ENGLISH-language 'Egg Pizza' profile (https://pizzadb.jp/en/pizzas/breakfast-pizza/) with an identical ingredient set -- an EN-sourced cross-language corroboration, provenance kept explicit as EN not rewritten as Japanese-page evidence, per the trigger comment's explicit instruction. Full per-batch breakdown in the corroborations array itself. Recorded as corroborations (new source URL added to the matched row's evidence trail), never double-counted toward evidencedCount.
recipeRowEvidence.individualProfilePageAccessNote: Phase 0B.4 found that direct pagination URLs (/compare/world-pizzas/page/7 etc.) fail for the relaying agent, but individual /pizzas/<slug>/ profile pages remain fetchable via search -- so the remaining population can be evidenced via accumulated individual profiles, not only via pagination. Phase 0B.13, 0B.14, and 0B.15 all confirmed this: pages 13-15 remain inaccessible via pagination, but individual-profile recovery continues to add new rows (and, increasingly, deep-profile corroborations of already-evidenced rows) via direct ingredient-tag-page -> individual-profile navigation, now also cross-checked against PIZZA DB's English-language profile index as a candidate/difference locator (Phase 0B.15). pendingPages above is retained as a reference to the original access path, not a claim that it is the only viable one going forward.

ingredientOccurrenceEvidence.corroborationNote: 36 (tier >=5) + 145 (tiers 4/3/2/1) = 181, which matches EXACTLY the historical '160 canonical pizzas / 181 unique ingredients' figure already on record in docs/design/TETO_RECIPE-MASTER-CATALOG.md section 1 (a figure from prior, separate sessions' PIZZA DB research). This is a strong internal-consistency signal that the ingredient-name universe is now fully enumerated down to occurrence=1 -- but it remains an owner-relayed claim, not independently re-fetched by this Claude session (still EGRESS_BLOCKED), so 'likely, not certain' is the honest status rather than 'true'.
ingredientOccurrenceEvidence.note: IMPORTANT: these are INGREDIENT OCCURRENCE COUNTS (how many of the 172 recipes use this ingredient), not a count of recipes and not a substitute for recipeRowEvidence above. tools/progression2_evidence_invariants.py checks the two are never conflated. recipeRowEvidence.evidencedCount is UNCHANGED at 25/172 by this ingestion -- ingredient-name completeness does not imply recipe-row completeness.
